newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery Ward unit buys legal plan provider.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery Ward unit buys legal plan provider.

text.p: Montgomery Ward Holding Corp's Signature Group subsidiary said Friday it has acquired Prudential LegalCare, a company that sells legal service plans to employers, from Prudential Insurance Co of America.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed. Prudential LegalCare had $10.6 million in revenues in 1996, Signature Group said.

Prudential LegalCare provides employees with access to legal assistance through a network of nearly 9,500 attorneys, Signature Group said. Its products offer legal services via toll-free legal advice line or attorney referral as part of a flexible benefit plan or an employee assistance plan.
Signature Group owns and manages its own legal services plan - The Legal Services Plan of America - with a network of approximately 2,000 attorneys, Montgomery Ward said.
